automatable_note: A jumper is fitted on the two gold contacts before power is applied and pulled off after the ESC's first tone sequence. The bench has no actuator for the jumper, so a person does both; the run asks for each step.

manual.action: Fit the jumper on the two gold contacts.
manual.action_de: Jumper auf die beiden Goldkontakte stecken.

manual.action: Pull the jumper off after 5 s or the tone sequence.
manual.action_de: Jumper nach 5 s oder der Tonfolge abziehen.

entry.confirm_signal: Tone sequence after the 5 s wait.
steps: Operator: fit the jumper. Connect the motor if tones are to be audible.
Transmitter and receiver on. Throttle to brake (stick back); mode 3: motor-off (stick back); mode 6: motor-off (stick middle).
Wait 5 s or until the ESC sounds its tone sequence.
Move the throttle to full when the wanted mode sounds. Mode 6: then stick to brake (back). Mode 4: the jumper can be fitted again to enable a start button.
Control output repeats the mode. Disconnect power.

announce.description: The ESC sounds mode 1 as one tone, mode 2 as two tones, and so on, one series after another with a pause between series.

select.description: Throttle to full during the wanted series.

scheme.description: Jumper procedure with a 5 s wait (the other jumper families wait 2 s). Mode N is N tones. The ESC drives brushed motors.

values.name: APM: reset, stick range learned at every power-up
Glider: brake about 0.3 s, cutoff 0.8 V per cell, optional separate motor-off position
Motor plane / boat: brake off, cutoff off, power reduced below 5.5 V
Helicopter: throttle compensation for falling battery voltage, linear curve, optional start button

unknowns: Duration of one tone in ms is not stated.

notes: The BEC type for StarBEC 40-6-12 is not stated; the bec field there reflects no manual statement.
Mode 6 is programmed with the stick at motor-off in the middle (Kontronik_Star-Line.pdf p.6): entry_throttle mid.
Mode 6 moves the stick to the brake position (back) after the full-throttle selection (Kontronik_Star-Line.pdf p.6): after_select min, made STORE after the selection; the manual gives no time.
